name: STAR Cross-solver verification fabric
summary: Runs engines of declared lineage (each optionally in its own venv) on the same inputs; AGREE only with >= 2 distinct lineages within tolerance, failed engines never count, published references compared; tamper-evident sha256 evidence bundles.
reference: XC-001 geocentric Moon distance: JPL DE440 via SPICE / skyfield / jplephem (one lineage) vs PyEphem/libastro vs ERFA builtin
reference_observed: DE440 engines agree to 0.000 km; PyEphem 0.07-0.11 km; astropy builtin 1.4-38 km within 50 km -> AGREE on 3 epochs; same-lineage engines counted as one witness

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: unit is declared per quantity and carried in the bundle
review.G-06: engines are third-party libraries in their own venvs, registered in THIRD_PARTY_MANIFEST
review.G-08: subprocess only for isolated engines (inputs via stdin JSON); no network
review.G-13: failed engine -> DEGRADED with the error; fewer than 2 lineages -> INSUFFICIENT_INDEPENDENCE; reference miss -> DISAGREE
